---
title: "Handout 2 Problems"
---

Suppose that you have a perfectly shuffled deck of 52 playing cards and draw 5 cards. 


1. How many ways could you get a royal flush (same suit for 10, J, Q, K, A)?
2. How many ways could you get a straight flush without having a royal flush (same suit for sequence of 5 cards)?
3. How many ways could you get a four of a kind?
4. How many ways could you get a 3 of a kind and a pair?
5. How many ways could you get a 3 of a kind without a pair?
6. How many ways could you get a hand without any pairs, three of kind, or four of a kind?

--- 

7. How many possible ways could you receive your five cards?
8. How would you calculate probabilities for 1-6?
